prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render. This input is an exact orthographic production geometry blockout, NOT a mood image. Materialize it as a realistic hand-crafted ancient southern Xinjiang oasis-town map sprite. Preserve the input camera, framing, every major outer boundary and especially the three lowest footprint corners PIXEL EXACTLY. Do NOT rotate, re-project, tilt, enlarge, narrow, or reposition the blockout. Its ground axes are exactly +0.5 and -0.5 slopes, yaw45 elevation30, required for grid assembly. Add fine weathered ochre adobe, local pale stone foundation, honest timber grain and carved wood screens. Restrained highly detailed realistic historic strategy-game art; no plastic/toy look. Upper-left light, tiny lower-right contact shadow. Keep real transparent RGBA outside silhouette. No text, numbers, guide marks, border, watermark, people, animals, modern objects, landscape, or thick floating display slab. Ground is a flat thin contact surface. All new detail stays WITHIN the guide silhouette. Footprint front-to-side lengths exactly 12:9. Preserve this rectangular courtyard inn massing. Back and side lodging wings have two storeys, recessed wooden balcony gallery facing inner courtyard, front gate in exact existing gap. Earthen flat roofs with low parapets, timber doors/screens, a few rolled travel bundles within court. Lowest vertices left(208,580), front(848,900), right(1328,660).
